Name: Save from Book
Author: 986Fourmis
Description:
[center][color=#E9B46B][size=6][b]🌻 SAVE FROM BOOK 🌻[/b][/size][/color]
[size=4]A little book for the days you want to keep.[/size]
Save from your farmhouse desk, without going to bed or starting another day.

__________________________________________________[/center]

[center][color=#E9B46B][size=4][b]📚 ABOUT THE MOD 📚[/b][/size][/color][/center]

Inspired by the desk book in Fields of Mistria, Save From Book brings a familiar little saving ritual to Stardew Valley. Place your saving book on a table in your farmhouse, interact with it, and choose [b]Save game[/b]. Your current day becomes a book save you can return to later.

Your ordinary overnight save keeps its own place. Book saves appear beside it on Stardew's normal [b]Load Game[/b] page, with the saved farm, date and time.

[b]Standalone: requires only SMAPI.[/b]

[center]__________________________________________________
[color=#E9B46B][size=4][b]🌻 FEATURES 🌻[/b][/size][/color][/center]

[list]
[*][b]Save without sleeping.[/b] Keep your current day and time from the book in your farmhouse.[/*]
[*][b]Automatic replacement.[/b] Save game replaces your most recently saved book slot, without an extra overwrite prompt. Your first book save uses slot 01.[/*]
[*][b]Ten manual slots.[/b] Choose Other slots to keep separate snapshots. Replacing a manual slot or loading one asks for confirmation.[/*]
[*][b]Book saves on Load Game.[/b] Pick a Book 01, Book 02, etc. entry directly from the title screen. Pick the ordinary farmer entry for your overnight save.[/*]
[*][b]A free starter book.[/b] A letter offers one free book per farm's saved timeline, including farms started before installing the mod.[/*]
[*][b]More books at Robin's.[/b] Additional saving books cost 500g at the Carpenter's Shop.[/*]
[*][b]Native brown book furniture.[/b] A small, familiar Stardew book for your farmhouse table.[/*]
[*][b]Keyboard and controller support.[/b] Use arrows and Enter, or controller directions and A, in the slot menu. Escape or B closes it.[/*]
[/list]
[center]__________________________________________________
[color=#E9B46B][size=4][b]📖 YOUR FIRST SAVING BOOK 📖[/b][/size][/color][/center]

1. Load your farm with the mod installed.
2. Open the saving-book letter in your mailbox.
3. Leave one inventory space free, then click the book to claim it.
4. Place it on a table in your farmhouse.
5. Use your usual interaction button while standing beside it.
6. Choose [b]Save game[/b] to update your latest book save, or [b]Other slots[/b] for the ten-slot menu.

A full inventory leaves the free book available to claim later. Loading a snapshot from before you claimed it restores that earlier inventory and claim state together.

[center]__________________________________________________
[color=#E9B46B][size=4][b]🌾 RETURN TO YOUR DAY 🌾[/b][/size][/color][/center]

From the title screen, open [b]Load Game[/b] and select the book entry you want. You do not need to load your overnight farm first. The ordinary save stays as a separate entry.

Read letters, claimed mail items and inventory are restored together. Native save/load tests checked that repeatedly loading an already-claimed mail reward did not grant the items again, and that loading an earlier snapshot restored its earlier inventory instead.

The trash button on a [b]book entry[/b] asks before removing that slot from the list. It keeps your ordinary farm save and other book slots. The ordinary farmer entry still uses Stardew's usual farm-deletion behavior.

[center]__________________________________________________
[color=#E9B46B][size=4][b]🌻 REQUIREMENTS 🌻[/b][/size][/color][/center]

[b]Current release: 0.3.0[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15[/b][/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] [b]4.5.2[/b][/*]
[*]Single-player[/*]
[/list]
This release uses game-specific saving adapters and enables saving only on these exact verified versions. Multiplayer and split-screen are unsupported. Use the book while your farmer is free to move in the farmhouse; finish active events, festivals, minigames or conversations first.

[center]__________________________________________________
[color=#E9B46B][size=4][b]🪵 INSTALL WITH VORTEX 🪵[/b][/size][/color][/center]

1. Set Vortex to manage Stardew Valley.
2. Install SMAPI 4.5.2 if needed.
3. Add [b]SaveFromBook.zip[/b] to Vortex and install it.
4. Enable the mod and deploy your mods.
5. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.

The archive contains one standard SMAPI mod folder named [b]SaveFromDesk[/b]. If updating an existing installation, replace that copy and keep only one installation of the mod.

[center]__________________________________________________
[color=#E9B46B][size=4][b]🪵 INSTALL WITHOUT VORTEX 🪵[/b][/size][/color][/center]

1. Install SMAPI 4.5.2.
2. Extract SaveFromBook.zip.
3. Put the [b]SaveFromDesk[/b] folder inside your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI, then load your farm.

[center]__________________________________________________
[color=#E9B46B][size=4][b]🍂 SAVES, UPDATES & REMOVAL 🍂[/b][/size][/color][/center]

Book slots belong to your original farm save folder. Keep the whole farm folder together when making a backup or moving it to another computer. Older save generations are retained for recovery and use disk space, even when you replace a visible book slot.

Book saves check the game version and installed mod IDs and versions before loading. Keep the same game and mod setup when returning to a snapshot. Standalone 0.2.0 book saves can be opened in 0.3.0 when the game and all other mod versions match. The historical QuickSave-dependent 0.1.0 saves are not automatically converted.

Before uninstalling, keep your progress in an ordinary overnight save. Removing the mod leaves the decorative book furniture in your farm. Book entries need this mod to appear and restore correctly; the ordinary overnight save remains available without it.

[center]__________________________________________________
[color=#E9B46B][size=4][b]🔧 TROUBLESHOOTING 🔧[/b][/size][/color][/center]

[b]No free book?[/b] Check the mailbox after loading your farm. Leave an empty inventory space and click the book inside the letter.

[b]The book will not open?[/b] Use the saving book supplied by this mod, placed on a table in your farmhouse, and stand beside it.

[b]Saving is refused?[/b] Check the exact game and SMAPI versions above. Finish the active conversation, event or animation, then try again. The mod refuses runtime states its saving adapters cannot safely represent.

[b]A slot will not load?[/b] Keep its files together and use the game and mod versions from when it was saved. If an operation returns to title with a restart instruction, restart the game before trying again. The previous committed slot is retained when replacement fails.

[b]Compatibility and testing:[/b] This is a development release tested in the native game for the documented save/load, mail, reward, title-menu and failure scenarios. Every late-game state and other mod's private data has not been exhaustively tested. See the included verification report for coverage.
